provider: Microsoft Azure Free Account — Blob Storage

free_tier.stated: 5 GB locally redundant storage (LRS) hot block with 20,000 read and 10,000 write operations, for 12 months

egress.terms: Internet egress: 'First 100 GB/Month | Free' from every source continent, for all Azure customers, in perpetuity (not part of the 12-month offer).

tooling: Azure Blob REST API; rclone 'azureblob' backend; azcopy; SAS tokens/public containers for anonymous reads.
chaining: One free account per customer, and the 5 GB ends at month 12 while the storage keeps running and starts billing. A negative multiplier unless torn down. $200 credit is 30 days.
limits_note: 5 GB for 12 months then paid (~$0.0184/GB-month hot LRS). 100 GB/month egress is the binding constraint for serving.
reliability_note: Stable while it lasts; the failure mode is silent conversion to pay-as-you-go at month 12 with data still resident.
